title: The chain atom W=u^5v+v^6: Milnor number 25, diagonal symmetry 30, and the transpose shift +1
description: Isolated invertible plane-curve singularity W=u^5v+v^6. Records μ(W)=25 versus |Aut(W)|=30, the Berglund-Hübsch transpose W^T with μ=26, Steenbrink spectra, monodromy characteristic polynomials, and the Thom-Sebastiani product of three copies. Not a Hodge miss.
